description: Get the user's own files (photos, video, PDFs, documents) into their oriiion account when you only have them inside this conversation. Returns a short-lived link the user opens in a browser and drops files on; then call list_uploaded_files for the stored URLs, which work with create_post_from_image, create_carousel_from_images, create_post_from_video and create_document_post. IF YOU HOLD THE FILE AND CAN MAKE HTTP REQUESTS, skip this — it needs nothing from the user: call create_media_upload_url, PUT the bytes, then finalize_media_upload (up to 200MB, no API key needed). If the file is already online, call import_media_from_url. Use this link tool when you cannot make HTTP requests or the file only exists as an attachment in the chat.

note.description: Optional short note about what the user should upload — shown to you, not to them

name: create_upload_link
title: Create Upload Link
